items.description: Verify the loading report data for VSL-06, ensuring the cargo quantity of 68,000 mt of wheat is accurately recorded, with loading commenced on 10 Oct at 12:00 and expected completion by 14 Oct.
Update the vessel schedule for VSL-06 to reflect that it berthed on 10 Oct at 08:00 and commenced loading on 10 Oct at 12:00, with completion expected around 14 Oct.
